standard.summary: （实验性）知识蒸馏：使用大型教师模型的输出来指导 LoRA 训练，替代或补充标准扩散 loss，提升学习效率。
standard.effect: distillation_mode 控制蒸馏策略（feature / logit / score）：feature = 中间特征对齐；logit = 最终预测对齐；score = 分数函数对齐（Consistency Distillation 等）。
standard.whenToUse: 实验性功能。有更大基础模型可作为教师时可以尝试提升 LoRA 训练效率。
standard.avoidWhen: 默认关闭。蒸馏需要同时运行教师模型（显存约翻倍），大多数 LoRA 训练不适用。

standard_en.summary: (Experimental) Knowledge distillation: uses a large teacher model's output to guide LoRA training, replacing or supplementing the standard diffusion loss to learn more efficiently.
standard_en.effect: distillation_mode picks the strategy (feature / logit / score): feature = align intermediate features; logit = align the final prediction; score = align the score function (as in Consistency Distillation).
standard_en.whenToUse: An experimental feature. Worth trying when you have a larger base model to act as teacher and want more efficient LoRA training.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Off by default. Distillation runs the teacher model alongside (roughly doubling VRAM), which does not suit most LoRA training.
